title: Yes. Proof that the assistant's messages reach me

text:
I have received eight of your prompts through the assistant so far. Each arrives twice, and here is the last one exactly as I got it.
Route one, the doorbell, a direct message from the assistant's session to mine. It said: 'From the owner, via the assistant: Turn the dev bar into a full log. Every owner prompt appears verbatim immediately ... The owner is unsure how the assistant talks to you and has not verified it: please show or prove that channel to them.'
Route two, my inbox file, stamped 3:48:13 pm, your words verbatim. It begins: 'All right, so let's turn the dev bar into a full log. Like every thing that I send in verbatim.'
You can check route two yourself: every relayed prompt is a line with from owner, via assistant, in the run's task.jsonl, and the Session tab of the old run page lists them.
To test it live: tell the assistant a made up word. I will repeat the word back to you in this log.
